mentions.name: shadml
mentions.description: A shader programming language mixing Haskell and F# features that transpiles to WGSL. It supports traits, bitfields, algebraic data types (ADTs), and module/import externs for binding to other WGSL code. The project was born from a fork called fwgsl and is in very early stages.
mentions.problem: The author got tired of the lack of functional programming features in WGSL.
mentions.source_excerpt: So making a new language that is a mix of haskell and F# that transpiles to wgsl. It has traits, bitfields, adts, module/imports externs to bind to other wgsl. Was born from a fork called fwgsl.
